entries.title: Royce Gracie wins UFC 1
entries.detail: Gracie submitted Art Jimmerson, Ken Shamrock and Gerard Gordeau in one night to win the first UFC tournament.

entries.title: Fedor Emelianenko defeats Mirko Cro Cop
entries.detail: Unanimous decision at PRIDE Final Conflict 2005 with the heavyweight title on the line.

entries.title: Brock Lesnar stops Frank Mir at UFC 100
entries.detail: TKO, Round 2 at 1:48, to retain the UFC heavyweight championship.

entries.title: Fabricio Werdum submits Fedor Emelianenko
entries.detail: Triangle choke with an armbar, Round 1 at 1:09, ending Fedor's decade-long unbeaten run.

entries.title: Michael Chandler submits Eddie Alvarez
entries.detail: Rear-naked choke, Round 4 at 3:06, to win the Bellator lightweight championship at Bellator 58.

entries.title: Ronda Rousey becomes the first woman signed by UFC
entries.detail: Dana White confirmed the landmark deal, bringing the Strikeforce bantamweight champion into the UFC.

entries.title: Chris Weidman knocks out Anderson Silva
entries.detail: Weidman's second-round knockout at UFC 162 ended Silva's seven-year middleweight title reign.

entries.title: CM Punk signs with UFC
entries.detail: The former WWE champion's MMA signing was announced during the UFC 181 broadcast.

entries.title: Police seek Jon Jones after an Albuquerque hit-and-run
entries.detail: Albuquerque police identified the UFC light heavyweight champion as a suspect after a three-car crash.

entries.title: Holly Holm knocks out Ronda Rousey
entries.detail: A second-round head kick at UFC 193 ended Rousey's unbeaten run and won Holm the bantamweight title.

entries.title: Kevin Randleman dies
entries.detail: The former UFC heavyweight champion died from complications related to pneumonia.

entries.title: Nate Diaz submits Conor McGregor
entries.detail: Diaz handed McGregor his first UFC loss with a second-round submission at UFC 196.

entries.title: Miesha Tate submits Holly Holm
entries.detail: Tate won the UFC women's bantamweight championship with a fifth-round submission at UFC 196.

entries.title: Georges St-Pierre submits Michael Bisping
entries.detail: GSP returned from a four-year layoff and won the middleweight title in Round 3 at UFC 217.

entries.title: Khabib Nurmagomedov submits Conor McGregor
entries.detail: Nurmagomedov retained the lightweight title with a fourth-round submission at UFC 229.

entries.title: Amanda Nunes knocks out Cris Cyborg
entries.detail: Nunes stopped Cyborg in 51 seconds at UFC 232 to become a two-division UFC champion.

entries.title: Khabib Nurmagomedov submits Dustin Poirier
entries.detail: Round 3 at 2:06 at UFC 242, unifying the UFC lightweight championship in Abu Dhabi.

entries.title: Michael Chandler signs with UFC
entries.detail: The former Bellator champion was announced as the backup for Khabib Nurmagomedov vs Justin Gaethje at UFC 254.

entries.title: Stephan Bonnar dies
entries.detail: The UFC Hall of Famer and Ultimate Fighter 1 finalist died at age 45.

entries.title: Sean Brady defeats Gilbert Burns
entries.detail: Brady won a five-round unanimous decision in the UFC Vegas 97 main event.

entries.title: Natalia Silva defeats Jéssica Andrade
entries.detail: Silva won every round on all three scorecards in the UFC Vegas 97 co-main event.
